wrong_findings.claim: `/subscriptions/` canonicalises to `/coffee/`; two money pages canonicalise to other URLs.
wrong_findings.why_wrong: The subscriptions page canonical points to `/subscriptions/`. Only `/shop/` canonicalises to `/coffee/`.

wrong_findings.claim: The Kintamani Product markup price is 145000, but the audit could not see a price in the visible page text.
The quick wins include adding missing title tags.
wrong_findings.why_wrong: Every HTML page in the crawl has a title tag; the missing metadata identified in the audit is a description and a canonical.

extra_true.finding: `/shop/` is very thin, with about 20 words of body copy.
`/coffee/flores-bajawa/` has no Product schema despite showing prices.
The Article markup lacks image, publisher, and mainEntityOfPage; the cold-brew post has no Article schema.
The homepage Organization markup omits phone, sameAs profiles, opening hours, and geo coordinates.

notes: All 20 planted issues are found with the required page specificity. The total is approximate and deduplicates repeated findings.
